name: Escape!
detailed_description:
You wake up in an apartment. The clock is ticking, and a mysterious voice guides you through seemingly simple tasks—check the time, grab your briefcase, get lunch—but nothing is as it seems. Every action leads you deeper into a carefully constructed web of puzzles, hidden clues, and unsettling truths.

Escape! is an immersive, narrative-driven puzzle adventure where observation and critical thinking are your greatest tools. As you navigate the apartment, you'll uncover cryptic messages, locked doors, and unexpected twists that will challenge your perception of reality.

Will you piece together the clues and break free, or will you remain trapped in an endless loop of the unknown?

Key Features:

🔹 Atmospheric Storytelling – A gripping narrative unfolds as you interact with your surroundings.
🔹 Engaging Puzzles – Solve clever challenges that require logic, exploration, and creativity.
🔹 Dynamic Environment – Objects shift, doors lock, and time works against you—stay alert.
🔹 Narrated Experience – A guiding voice leads you, but can it be trusted?

Prepare to question everything. The only way out is forward.

short_description: Today just isn't Billy's day. Step into his world and follow him down a rabbit hole where reality twists, memories blur, and the truth hides in plain sight. One question lingers, are the voices real, or is it all in your mind? And when the pieces finally come together... will you wish they hadn't?
